description: This file defines the MonkeyRotationEvent class, which represents a rotation event used in the Android Monkey testing framework. It includes logic to inject a rotation change via the IWindowManager interface and supports persisting the rotation state.

classes.name: MonkeyRotationEvent
classes.description: Represents a rotation event in the Monkey testing framework that can be injected into the system to rotate the screen to a specified degree, optionally persisting the rotation. Extends MonkeyEvent

methods.name: MonkeyRotationEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rotation degree and persistence flag.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the rotation event into the system by calling the appropriate methods on IWindowManager, handling remote exceptions.
